title: Leek Lentil and Orzo Potage
ingredients: 1 fennel bulb, trimmed and finely chopped
400g (14oz) can of green lentils, drained and rinsed
small handful of basil leaves, finely chopped, plus extra to serve
method: Spray a casserole dish or deep saucepan with oil and stir-fry the tomatoes over a high heat for 2 minutes.
Add the shallots and garlic to the pan and fry for a further 3 minutes.
Add the celery, fennel and leek and fry for another 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Pour in the hot stock, add the orzo, lentils and courgette and simmer gently for 15-20 minutes until the orzo is cooked through.
Season to taste, stir through most of the chopped basil and serve with a little more basil scattered over.
notes: Omit orzo to make pasta-free. Stir through 1 teaspoon of pesto or harissa paste for extra flavour.
